verdict.rationale: Meilisearch offers only narrow, task-specific background automation. Once an embedder is configured, it automatically generates embeddings for every document (meilisearch-docs-8), and the meilisync, Rails and Firebase integrations keep databases synced with indexes automatically (meilisearch-docs-71, meilisearch-docs-87, meilisearch-docs-85, meilisearch-docs-86). None of this is a general facility for AI-native users to define their own autonomous automations. Missing for 10: user-defined automations or workflows, scheduling or triggers, autonomous agent runs, and independent corroboration.
